item.grappin.grappin.aide1: Right click: fire the hook (30 blocks); it only holds on an anchor point
item.grappin.grappin.aide2: Hooked: swing; scroll wheel = shorten or lengthen the rope
item.grappin.grappin.aide3: Sneak: let go with a jump; hold jump: reel in; right click while hooked: let go and fire again
